newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bankinter issues 10 bln ptas subordinated bonds.
newsitem.headline: Bankinter issues 10 bln ptas subordinated bonds.

text.p: Spain's Bankinter will this week launch 10 billion pesetas of 10-year subordinated bonds, aimed at institutional investors, the bank said on Tuesday.
The nominal will be 25 million pesetas, with an annual coupon of 6.95 percent. Expiry will be at par.
A request will be made for the bonds to be admitted to trade on Spain's fixed income market.
The issue will be counted as part of the bank's shareholders' funds (Tier II), and is underwritten by JP Morgan, Merrill Lynch, Caja Madrid and Bilbao Bizcaya Kutxa.
At March 31, Bankinter had a solvency coefficient of 13.46 percent.
